validation.test_history: New Brown destruction assertion initially used a soft blast, which only removes dung hits. Corrected fixture to spent-dynamite demolition, then reran the failed suite successfully. Earlier five regression suites passed; original failed run is retained.

checked: All26HP/size/contact modifiers with ordinary and permanent-Charm affiliation; stationary variants never acquire autonomous walking.
Green/Brown trails require physical movement. Brown droppings break under dynamite without loot.
White immunity releases without softlock; Black/Camouflage reveal behavior; spectral body/own death shot retain room bounds after owner cleanup.
Magenta fires independently at rest and retries under projectile pressure, including already queued shots. Violet/Gray fields and PulsingRed healing work on this body.
DarkRed collapse emits no own death shot/reward, revives, and final finishing pays once.
Every type retains the ordinary final shot; LightBlue/Rainbow add8for9total, without replacing or duplicating the base shot.
PulsingGreen creates two ordinary source-HP copies, retaining functional permanent Charm and safe descendant shots.
LightWhite orbiter releases plus extra fly; Pulsating caps offspring at5; Crown coloring and Skull chained deaths preserve correct per-body rewards and shots.
Orange final-shot coin loss remains after the owner is removed.
Production resident preparation selects seeded champions with stage gates; default tuning unchanged.
fixes: Enabled ordinary812.0through the shared champion eligibility checks; Tainted812.1remains excluded.
Reactive Green/Brown/Rainbow movement trails no longer accumulate while stationary.
Magenta checks queued shots as well as live projectiles before consuming its extra-shot timer.
Profiled permanently charmed champion offspring receive status runtime so their shots keep allegiance.
adaptations: Existing HP/size/generic combat definitions are reused; effect strengths, aura forces, delays and movement tuning are DeathWard values rather than exact native champion-engine recovery.

Yellow/Gray/DarkBlue speed modifiers do not manufacture autonomous motion or multiply external SubHorf recoil. This is the local stationary-body policy; exact native special impulse modifiers remain unverified.
Existing one-orbiter LightWhite policy is retained; wiki allows1-2. Global uniform eligible-type selection and ordinary DeathWard loot remain unchanged.
remaining: Isaac-specific champion pickup rewards and native rarity weighting remain unimplemented/adapted in the shared system.
Real pickup-to-status triggers and full body/build/status interaction matrix remain open.
Exact native champion knockback/status/item exceptions, mixed-room/all-angle visual acceptance, human balance and dense rendered performance remain open.
Tainted Sub Horf812.1is a separate missing actor.
